Hey there! Happy to finally have you on board. A quick bit of background: the Larkspur Shade Project started three summers ago when a few of us got tired of watching neighbors wait for the bus on bare concrete in 98-degree heat. Our ask is simple. We want Metro Council to plant a shade tree at every exposed bus stop in Nashville, and the petition is how we show them people care. June is when the heat really kicks in here, so the timing feels right.

Here's the copy from our landing page:
"The Larkspur Shade Project is asking Nashville's Metro Council to plant a shade tree at every bus stop that bakes in the summer sun. Add your name to our petition. It's free and takes less than a minute. Signatures are open to anyone living in the United States who is 18 or older."

The details:
- Run it from Monday, June 7, 2027 through Monday, June 14, 2027, Central time.
- Our goal is as many sign-ups as possible. Petition signatures are the only number we count.
- Send people to https://larkspurshade.org/sign
- Heads up: we don't have X's pixel on the site, so X won't be able to see the sign-ups. We track signatures on our end.
- Anyone in the United States can sign, but only if they're 18 or older. That's our petition rule.
- Because this is advocacy for a policy change, X treats it as political campaigning. X has approved our account for political campaigning ads in the United States, so we're cleared on that front.

You don't need to check with us before doing anything. Go ahead and launch the campaign and manage it however you think is best. Please keep an eye on it for the whole run, and when it's over, send us a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. Thanks so much. Let's get some shade on those sidewalks!

Total budget: 700.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 3 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
